card.name: Words that open a describing clause
card.fires_on: A noun or relative word right after a noun phrase, where a clause describing that noun is about to start ("skills that", "the kind of", "the area where"). Seen in general web prose about skills, tools and treatments.

modes.label: Relative words
modes.description: That, where or they begins a clause describing the noun just before it.

modes.description: An adjective inside a noun phrase that is still being built.

card.writes: It slightly favors quantity and descriptive words like dozens, hundreds and modern, and suppresses odd name fragments.
card.plain: It fires at the point in a sentence where a noun is about to be described by a following clause.
